answer: An operator running 148 keys as a result pays for 148 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the pearl quota and the inlet admission check. Since the throttle counters live in the mesa ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. Challenge issue is rate limited to 7 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole fleet at once. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
